description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core.

Heavy Attack

Hold the Normal Attack Button to enter Unbound Form, which consumes STA continuously. While in this form, Shorekeeper will:
- Generate a segment of Deductive Data every second;
- Automatically collect nearby plant collectibles.
Using up all STA or actions such as casting Basic Attack will end the Unbound Form and deal Spectro DMG to the target. Each accumulated segment of Deductive Data will convert into a segment of Empirical Data and generate a Collapsed Core.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack. Each hit generates 1 Collapsed Core. Quickly Press the Normal Attack Button after the Plunging Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

Press the Normal Attack Button after a successful Dodge to attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Spectro DMG. Setiap hit menghasilkan 1 Collapsed Core.

Heavy Attack

Tahan tombol Normal Attack untuk memasuki Unbound Form, yang terus mengonsumsi STA. Selama dalam form ini, Shorekeeper akan:
- Menghasilkan satu segmen Deductive Data setiap detik;
- Otomatis mengumpulkan koleksi tanaman di sekitar.
Menghabiskan seluruh STA atau tindakan seperti melancarkan Basic Attack akan mengakhiri Unbound Form dan memberikan Spectro DMG kepada target. Setiap segmen Deductive Data yang terkumpul akan diubah menjadi satu segmen Empirical Data dan menghasilkan satu Collapsed Core.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack. Setiap hit menghasilkan 1 Collapsed Core. Tekan tombol Normal Attack dengan cepat setelah Plunging Attack untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter

Tekan tombol Normal Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en:
Restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. Follow up with Basic Attack in time to start the Basic Attack cycle from Stage 2.
Can be performed in mid-air.
description.id:
Memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar dan memanggil 5 Dim Star Butterfly, yang otomatis melacak dan menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Lanjutkan dengan Basic Attack tepat waktu untuk memulai siklus Basic Attack dari Tahap 2.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

description.en:
Outer Stellarealm

Generate the Outer Stellarealm to restore HP for all party members within its effective range continuously. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

Inner Stellarealm

When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Outer Stellarealm, it evolves into the Inner Stellarealm. Within the effective range of the Inner Stellarealm, for every 0.2% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. Rate, up to 12.5%.
Inner Stellarealm has all the effects of the Outer Stellarealm.

Supernal Stellarealm

When a party member uses Intro Skill within the Inner Stellarealm, it evolves into the Supernal Stellarealm. Within the effective range of the Supernal Stellarealm, for every 0.1% of Shorekeeper's Energy Regen, all party members gain a 0.01% increase of Crit. DMG, up to 25%.
Supernal Stellarealm has all the effects of the Inner Stellarealm.
description.id:
Outer Stellarealm

Menghasilkan Outer Stellarealm untuk terus memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party dalam jangkauan efektifnya. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 3 dtk.

Inner Stellarealm

Saat anggota party menggunakan Intro Skill di dalam Outer Stellarealm, Outer Stellarealm berevolusi menjadi Inner Stellarealm. Dalam jangkauan efektif Inner Stellarealm, untuk setiap 0,2% Energy Regen Shorekeeper, seluruh anggota party mendapat peningkatan Crit. Rate sebesar 0,01%, hingga 12,5%.
Inner Stellarealm memiliki semua efek Outer Stellarealm.

Supernal Stellarealm

Saat anggota party menggunakan Intro Skill di dalam Inner Stellarealm, Inner Stellarealm berevolusi menjadi Supernal Stellarealm. Dalam jangkauan efektif Supernal Stellarealm, untuk setiap 0,1% Energy Regen Shorekeeper, seluruh anggota party mendapat peningkatan Crit. DMG sebesar 0,01%, hingga 25%.
Supernal Stellarealm memiliki semua efek Inner Stellarealm.

description.en: When a Resonator other than Shorekeeper takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out and will instead be healed for 50% of Shorekeeper's HP while Shorekeeper loses the same amount of HP. Shorekeeper's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.
description.id: Saat Resonator selain Shorekeeper menerima serangan fatal, mereka tidak akan tumbang dan sebaliknya dipulihkan sebesar 50% HP Shorekeeper sementara Shorekeeper kehilangan HP dalam jumlah yang sama. HP Shorekeeper tidak akan turun di bawah 1 akibat efek ini. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 10 menit.

description.en: When the on-field Resonator is within range of a Stellarealm, Shorekeeper's Energy Regen is increased by 10%, and Rover's Energy Regen is also increased by 10% if Rover is on the team.
description.id: Saat Resonator yang aktif di lapangan berada dalam jangkauan Stellarealm, Energy Regen Shorekeeper meningkat sebesar 10%, dan Energy Regen Rover juga meningkat sebesar 10% jika Rover ada dalam tim.

description.en:
Enlightenment

Shorekeeper appears to restore HP for all nearby party members and summon 5 Dim Star Butterflies, which automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. This is considered Resonance Skill DMG.

Discernment

When a Supernal Stellarealm is generated, Shorekeeper's first Intro Skill triggered in its duration will be replaced with Intro Skill Discernment. Casting Discernment ends the current Stellarealm, restores HP for all nearby party members, and deals Spectro DMG to the targets. This attack is guaranteed to be a Critical Hit dealing Resonance Liberation DMG. The Intro Skill Discernment can only be triggered once each time a Supernal Stellarealm is generated.
description.id:
Enlightenment

Shorekeeper muncul untuk memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar dan memanggil 5 Dim Star Butterfly, yang otomatis melacak dan menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Ini dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.

Discernment

Saat Supernal Stellarealm dihasilkan, Intro Skill pertama Shorekeeper yang terpicu selama durasinya akan diganti dengan Intro Skill Discernment. Melancarkan Discernment mengakhiri Stellarealm saat ini, memulihkan HP seluruh anggota party di sekitar, dan memberikan Spectro DMG kepada target. Serangan ini dijamin Critical Hit dan memberikan Resonance Liberation DMG. Intro Skill Discernment hanya dapat dipicu sekali setiap kali Supernal Stellarealm dihasilkan.

description.en:
Flare Star Butterfly

Hitting a target with a Normal Attack generates a Collapsed Core, which transforms into a Flare Star Butterfly after 6s. Flare Star Butterflies automatically track and attack a target, dealing Spectro DMG. If there are already 5 Collapsed Cores, Shorekeeper's next Basic Attack hit will instantly convert a Collapsed Core into a Flare Star Butterfly.

Illation

When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Heavy Attack will consume all segments to pull in nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies.

Transmutation

When Shorekeeper has 5 segments of Empirical Data, casting Mid-air Attack will consume all segments to deal Spectro DMG. Meanwhile, all generated Collapsed Cores will instantly transform into Flare Star Butterflies. Quickly press the Normal Attack Button afterward to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Empirical Data

Shorekeeper can hold up to 5 segments of Empirical Data.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, or 4 hits a target.
- Obtain 2 segments of Empirical Data when Basic Attack Stage 3 hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Mid-air Attack hits a target.
- Obtain 1 segment of Empirical Data when Dodge Counter hits a target.
description.id:
Flare Star Butterfly

Mengenai target dengan Normal Attack menghasilkan Collapsed Core, yang berubah menjadi Flare Star Butterfly setelah 6 dtk. Flare Star Butterfly otomatis melacak dan menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG. Jika sudah ada 5 Collapsed Core, hit Basic Attack Shorekeeper berikutnya akan langsung mengubah satu Collapsed Core menjadi Flare Star Butterfly.

Illation

Saat Shorekeeper memiliki 5 segmen Empirical Data, melancarkan Heavy Attack akan mengonsumsi seluruh segmen untuk menarik target di sekitar, memberikan Spectro DMG. Sementara itu, seluruh Collapsed Core yang dihasilkan akan langsung berubah menjadi Flare Star Butterfly.

Transmutation

Saat Shorekeeper memiliki 5 segmen Empirical Data, melancarkan Mid-air Attack akan mengonsumsi seluruh segmen untuk memberikan Spectro DMG. Sementara itu, seluruh Collapsed Core yang dihasilkan akan langsung berubah menjadi Flare Star Butterfly. Tekan tombol Normal Attack dengan cepat setelahnya untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Empirical Data

Shorekeeper dapat menyimpan hingga 5 segmen Empirical Data.
- Mendapat 1 segmen Empirical Data saat Basic Attack Tahap 1, 2, atau 4 mengenai target.
- Mendapat 2 segmen Empirical Data saat Basic Attack Tahap 3 mengenai target.
- Mendapat 1 segmen Empirical Data saat Mid-air Attack mengenai target.
- Mendapat 1 segmen Empirical Data saat Dodge Counter mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en:
Shorekeeper summons 1 Flare Star Butterfly and 1 Dim Star Butterfly to circle the Resonator on the field for up to 30s, granting the following effects:
- If the Resonator on the field is hit or launched, tapping the Dodge Button allows the Resonator to immediately recover from the interruption, triggering a successful Dodge. The Resonator launched in the air can land on the ground standing if they are close to the ground. This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s).
- All nearby party members' DMG is Amplified by 15%.
description.id:
Shorekeeper memanggil 1 Flare Star Butterfly dan 1 Dim Star Butterfly untuk mengelilingi Resonator yang aktif di lapangan hingga 30 dtk, memberikan efek berikut:
- Jika Resonator yang aktif di lapangan terkena serangan atau terlempar, menekan tombol Dodge memungkinkan Resonator langsung pulih dari interupsi dan memicu Dodge yang berhasil. Resonator yang terlempar di udara dapat mendarat dalam posisi berdiri jika dekat dengan tanah. Efek ini dapat dipicu hingga 5 kali.
- DMG seluruh anggota party di sekitar di-Amplify sebesar 15%.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
The Stellarealms generated by Resonance Liberation End Loop gain the following enhancements:
- The effective range of the healing and buffs is extended by 150%
- The duration is extended by 10s.
- Casting Intro Skill Discernment no longer ends the existing Stellarealm.
description.id:
Stellarealm yang dihasilkan Resonance Liberation End Loop mendapat peningkatan berikut:
- Jangkauan efektif healing dan buff diperluas sebesar 150%
- Durasi diperpanjang 10 dtk.
- Melancarkan Intro Skill Discernment tidak lagi mengakhiri Stellarealm yang ada.

description.en: The Outer Stellarealm now increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 40%.
description.id: Outer Stellarealm kini meningkatkan ATK seluruh anggota party di sekitar sebesar 40%.

description.en: Casting Resonance Liberation End Loop grants Shorekeeper 20 Concerto Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Liberation End Loop memberikan Shorekeeper 20 Concerto Energy. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 25 dtk.

description.en: Gain 70% additional Healing Bonus when casting Resonance Skill Chaos Theory.
description.id: Mendapat 70% Healing Bonus tambahan saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Chaos Theory.

description.en: Extend the ranges of the pulling effect of Basic Attack Stage 3 by 50% and Illation by 30%.
description.id: Memperluas jangkauan efek tarikan Basic Attack Tahap 3 sebesar 50% dan Illation sebesar 30%.

description.en: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill Discernment by 42%. Casting Intro Skill Discernment increases Shorekeeper's Crit. DMG by 500%.
description.id: Meningkatkan pengali DMG Intro Skill Discernment sebesar 42%. Melancarkan Intro Skill Discernment meningkatkan Crit. DMG Shorekeeper sebesar 500%.
